summary: Cardholder C12975 reported unauthorized activity on card C12975-K2 regarding disputed transaction 3660260. An investigation identified six unauthorized online micro-authorizations for product C totaling $23.99 between January 5 and January 26, 2017, completely deviating from the card's in-person retail baseline. Network graph analysis confirmed an identical micro-billing pattern surging across 20 other customer accounts during the same period, indicating a coordinated multi-customer abuse scheme. The card was confirmed compromised under an undocumented fraud pattern, prompting card blocking, monitoring of connected accounts, and filing of a regulatory report.
open_question: Whether the micro-charges originate from a single compromised merchant aggregator or multiple rogue merchants, which would be resolved by inspecting the merchant IDs and acquirer processing data across the 20 peer cards.

waiting.why: R2: customer states they did not make the transaction; exposure $23.99
R9 and 3a: coordinated abuse that fits no documented pattern
